name: dsh-deepseek-keypool
description: DSH Provider 分档故障转移 —— 模型请求以额度/凭据/过载/限流等可切换失败结束时，按配置表档位顺序切换 harness 路由（provider）；凭据类失败先在条目内轮换 key（改写该路由的 apiKeyEnv 引用名，路由与模型不变），并按每日重置时刻恢复默认 key。设置页可查看并编辑每个条目的 key 引用（凭据引用名）与状态（在用/可用/失效[时间·错误]/未配置），并可做会话级测试切换（/failover-test 指令或按钮）。不持有也不读写任何凭据值。

metadata.author: wang
metadata.changelog: 3.3.0: transport failures now fail over to the next provider — 'websocket closed' joins the message-pattern fallback and TRANSPORT becomes a terminal code, so an un-normalized 'WebSocket closed 1000' (host maps it to generic PI_AI_ERROR) still switches (probe display aligned to 传输中断). policy (content/safety) failures now default to policyMode 'same' — keep the current provider/model and retry in-place within the same (turn, step) (bounded by maxPolicyRetriesPerStep), instead of switching provider; 'switch'/'off' restore the old policyFailover semantics. Prompt rewrite on retry is impossible (frozen loop requests + request-reconstruction invariant), documented in README. 3.2.4: adapt to dsh 0.2 (settings moved to the plugin-owned settings.json; active key ref now read via SettingsForms.describe), probe drives the file scope in an isolated DSH_HOME, and the isSwitchable policy comment matches the default policyFailover: true behavior.
